prompt.original: Use `building-a-promotion-case`. I'm a Senior PM at a Series C B2B SaaS company (150 people) and want to get promoted to Staff PM in the June cycle. I led the new enterprise onboarding flow (reduced TTV from 14 days to 3), drove a pricing migration affecting 2,000 accounts, and own the API platform roadmap. My company uses a 6-level IC ladder. My manager is supportive but says I need 'more visible cross-functional leadership.' Build a Promotion Case Pack with an evidence log, ladder-mapped narrative, manager alignment plan, and sponsor/visibility map. Output: Promotion Case Pack.
